name: @agentruntime/tools
description: 🛠️ Developer tools MCP — bash, file read/write/edit, glob, grep, web fetch

TOOLS.description: Comma-separated list of tools to register at startup. Omitting this env var enables ALL tools. Set to a restricted subset for read-only or sandboxed deployments.
TOOLS.security: Restricting this list is the primary mechanism for limiting surface area. A container without 'bash' cannot execute arbitrary shell commands. A container without 'write' and 'edit' is effectively read-only.

expose.notification: Developer tools online. Tools: run_command, read_file, write_file, edit_file, glob_files, grep_search, web_fetch.
